doc: x = cos(lat)cos(lon), y = cos(lat)sin(lon), z = sin(lat), float64, over the product of longitudes {0, +-pi, pi/2, +-1, +-1e3, 1e6, 7} (the antimeridian both ways, huge and unreduced angles) and latitudes {+-pi/2 (the poles, where cos is 6e-17, not 0), 0, +-0.3, 2.0, -3.0, pi (beyond the pole: cos < 0, no clamp)} plus 64 random pairs. Closed form: rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-12 (the pole x, y are ~1e-17).
